description.value: The Statue of Liberty walking tour starts with the official ferry. Statue City Cruises offers round-trip ferry service from either Battery Park in New York City or Liberty State Park in Jersey City. The ferry stops at Liberty Island and Ellis Island, so plan most of a day. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “The best part is access to the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island”. Representative watch-outs: “the loading and unloading process is crowded and disorganized”.
